Uses of Class
hadur2.core.memory.Estimate

Packages that use Estimate
Package
Description
hadur2.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur2.core.adapt
Recognise, then adapt (S4): the opening book that turns a loaded profile into decisions for the first tick (ADAPT-1, ADAPT-2), the seeds it replays into the KNN views at a lower weight (ADAPT-3), and the trust that fades those seeds when the opponent no longer behaves like its profile (RES-4).
hadur2.core.memory
Opponent memory (stage S3): one OpponentProfile per opponent lineage, folded from each round's observations (MEM-2), encoded in a small checksummed binary format (ProfileCodec) and kept in a ProfileStore by the ProfileLibrary (MEM-1, MEM-3 to MEM-5, RES-3).
hadur2.core.policy
Aggressive (S5): the policies that decide how close Hadur fights and how hard it shoots.
